strategic_conclusion: Events on January 7 were shaped by U.S. actions abroad: the seizure of sanctioned tankers under the Venezuela oil blockade, a directive withdrawing the United States from 66 international organizations including the UNFCCC and IPCC, and the suspension of assistance to Somalia's federal government. In Yemen, Saudi-led coalition airstrikes on Southern Transitional Council positions followed the dismissal of STC leader Aidarus al-Zoubaidi from the Presidential Leadership Council. Domestically in the United States, an ICE agent's fatal shooting of Renée Good in Minneapolis prompted Governor Tim Walz to prepare the National Guard. Anti-corruption proceedings advanced in Malaysia and Nigeria, and Cambodia extradited Prince Group founder Chen Zhi to China.
